title: GET /books ?author= is exact (case-insensitive) match only
evidence: src/main/java/books/BookServer.java:147 — SQL 'WHERE author = ? COLLATE NOCASE'; no substring/partial match. Spec only asks for a filter, so this satisfies R3.
suggestion: None required; a LIKE match would be a nicety, not a spec item.

title: Single shared JDBC connection with synchronized routing serializes all /books requests
evidence: src/main/java/books/BookServer.java:18,53 — one Connection field, route() is synchronized. Correct but not concurrent.
suggestion: Fine at this scale; a connection pool would be needed under load.

title: No pagination on GET /books
evidence: src/main/java/books/BookServer.java:146 list() returns the full table ORDER BY id.
suggestion: Not required by the spec; add ?limit/?offset only if scale demands it.
